lines.text: Two thirds of our planet is ocean, and almost all of it is completely dark.

scenes.headline: The Deep Sea
scenes.subtext: A short demo of the tube2dscript pipeline

lines.text: At four thousand meters, the pressure would crush a steel submarine like a tin can.
And yet something down there is making its own light.
Yet life survives here. Anglerfish that make their own light, giant squid the size of a bus, and bacteria that feed on bare rock.

scenes.headline: Yet Life Finds A Way

lines.text: We have mapped only twenty six percent of the sea floor in detail. The rest is still a blank page.
